purpose: Cited data layer for the two lease legs that the relative methods and the cross-method disclosure both consume: the operating lease cost added back to reach EBITDAR, and the long-term operating lease liability capitalised into Enterprise Value.
whyThisExists: P10.4 finding F2: rent lived as an uncited literal. A lease figure that feeds EV/EBITDAR must be a cited filing input with verified primary-source provenance.

leaseCost.label: Operating lease cost added back to EBITDA to reach EBITDAR

citation.statement: Note 9. Leases - Schedule of Components of Lease Cost (Details)

leaseCost.disclosure: Operating lease cost is an annual flow from FY2025 Form 10-K Note 9 (R58.htm) used as the annual run-rate add-back to forward EBITDA to reach forward EBITDAR, as interim 10-Qs under ASC 842 do not disclose quarterly lease cost components.

leaseLiability.label: Long-term operating lease liability capitalised into Enterprise Value
leaseLiability.disclosure: The current portion of operating lease liabilities is reported within accrued expenses and is not separately broken out in the quarterly filing; only the noncurrent operating lease liability line ($86,136k) is capitalised into Enterprise Value. That asymmetry is disclosed rather than smoothed over.

annualReference.label: FY2025 Form 10-K Note 9 operating lease cost, annual
annualReference.note: Quoted for the annual view in the cross-method disclosure. Reconciles with leaseCost.

citation.statement: Note 9. Leases - Schedule of Components of Lease Cost (Details)

gateRule: src/data/leaseGate.js requires every lease input to carry a filing citation with accession, statement and rendered-table URL, and requires a non-empty provenanceStatus. An input whose provenanceStatus begins with 'unverified' must be surfaced in disclosure as unverified rather than described as filed.
